normalization_explained: OrganizationalWorld::save_snapshot creates a Runtime copy and writes inert organizational.v1 chunks there. A live new Runtime may have none, a restored Runtime has a fresh envelope. Complete Runtime comparison removes ONLY that derived prefix on independent technical forks and normalizes backend options; actual RAW/clocks/tick/queue/channels/receipts/own protocol metadata remain. Organizational interfaces and external operations are compared separately.

ui_repairs.issue: Frontend sent salir twice after a completed event file
ui_repairs.resolution: Track closing response; retain first failed attempt and its exact frontend

ui_repairs.issue: Language loader admitted foreign pending teacher and unchecked protocol flags
ui_repairs.resolution: Safe loader validates neutral progress and complete receipts; no physics change

ui_repairs.issue: Failed cargar could replace live candidate before all protocol checks
ui_repairs.resolution: Transactional load; rejected commands leave live MAIN unchanged

ui_repairs.issue: Completed directional protocol rejected a later saved continuation
ui_repairs.resolution: Keep completed historical boundary while current tick may increase; do not reactivate old linguistic decoder

ui_repairs.issue: Test compared stale serialized organizational envelope with its newly saved representation
ui_repairs.resolution: Read native implementation, compare actual operative fields and normalized complete Runtime snapshots; no physical expectations changed; failed attempts retained

ui_repairs.issue: Technical dictionary comprehension used map iteration instead of items
ui_repairs.resolution: Corrected the test only, before final UI validation
